info.title: Converio - Recruiter Assignment API
info.description: Operator-only endpoints for the Recruiter Assignment Agent (Agent 0) HITL review surface. Operators fetch the current proposal, approve/reject it (which signals the running RecruiterAssignmentWorkflow), and poll workflow phase. Source of truth for the recruiter-assignment API contract; backend Pydantic models and frontend TS clients are generated from this file.

tags.name: Recruiter Assignment
tags.description: Operator HITL review of recruiter assignment proposals.

get.summary: Fetch the current recruiter assignment proposal for operator review
get.description: Returns the latest non-superseded proposal for `job_id`. Used by the operator console to render the HITL review screen. Operator-only; non-operators receive 403 before any DB IO.

403.description: Caller is not an active Converio operator.

404.description: No outstanding (non-superseded) proposal exists for this job.

post.summary: Send operator approval or rejection signal to RecruiterAssignmentWorkflow
post.description: Forward the operator's approve / reject decision to the running RecruiterAssignmentWorkflow as an `operator_approval` Temporal signal. The endpoint enriches the signal payload with `operator_id` (sourced from the auth context, NOT the request body) so the workflow's audit trail records who decided. Returns 202 immediately - the workflow consumes the signal asynchronously. Operator-only.

202.description: Signal dispatched to Temporal. Workflow will consume asynchronously.

403.description: Caller is not an active Converio operator.

404.description: No outstanding (non-superseded) proposal exists for this job.

422.description: Decision payload failed schema validation (e.g. `decision` not in {approve, reject}, or approve with empty recruiter sets).

502.description: Failed to dispatch the workflow signal to Temporal. Internal error details are not exposed.

get.description: Proxy to the running RecruiterAssignmentWorkflow's `current_phase` query handler. Used for live progress indicators in the operator console. Operator-only.

403.description: Caller is not an active Converio operator.

404.description: No proposal (and therefore no known workflow) exists for this job.

502.description: Failed to query the Temporal workflow. Internal error details are not exposed.

JobIdPath.name: job_id
JobIdPath.description: UUID of the Job whose recruiter-assignment proposal is being reviewed.

OperatorApprovalRequest.description: Operator's decision on a proposal. On `approve`, at least one of `confirmed_recruiter_ids` or `override_set` must be non-empty (operator must commit to a set). On `reject`, recruiter IDs are not required; `notes` carry the feedback channel back into the agent's re-loop prompt.

decision.description: Operator's verdict on the proposed set.

confirmed_recruiter_ids.description: Operator-confirmed subset of the proposed set; empty on reject.

override_set.description: Optional operator override - recruiters outside the proposed set.

notes.description: Free-form operator feedback; on reject this feeds back into the agent's re-loop prompt.

OperatorProposalResponse.description: Persisted recruiter-assignment proposal awaiting operator HITL review. The full agent decision context (candidates, fit scores, narratives, audit trail) is carried in `payload`; the operator UI renders that JSON directly.

proposal_id.description: Primary key of the operator_proposals row.

job_id.description: UUID of the Job under review.

workflow_id.description: Temporal workflow id for the running RecruiterAssignmentWorkflow.

quality_flag.description: Aggregate confidence bucket emitted by the agent.

payload.description: Full OperatorProposal JSON (proposed_recruiter_ids, candidates, fit_scores, narratives, audit_trail, totals). See app.schemas.product.recruiter_assignment.OperatorProposal for the canonical shape.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the proposal row was persisted.

OperatorProposalEnvelope.description: Standard ApiResponse envelope wrapping an OperatorProposalResponse.

OperatorDecisionAcceptedResponse.description: Standard ApiResponse envelope wrapping the dispatch acknowledgement for an operator decision.

RecruiterAssignmentStatusResponse.description: Standard ApiResponse envelope wrapping the workflow phase string.

ErrorResponse.description: FastAPI error response. `detail` is either a string (HTTPException) or a list of validation error objects.

oneOf.example: No proposal found for this job

BearerAuth.description: Supabase-issued JWT supplied as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Must resolve to an active Operator row.
